title: Execute local API test split prework
summary: Split the oversized application facade Local API and Web static test surfaces into focused domain-owned modules, leaving the former Local API file as an orientation shim and preserving assertion migration evidence.
reason: The former Local API facade test file had become too large to troubleshoot or extend safely. The split makes route, Web static, and cross-workflow coverage easier to target while keeping backend ownership guardrails covered by discovery tests.
behavior_before: Local API route and Web static contract coverage was concentrated in large facade test modules, including broad cross-domain methods that mixed queue, rename, diagnostics, settings, pending publish, and command-journal assertions.
behavior_after: Local API route coverage is grouped by HTTP/auth, diagnostics, network, repair, settings, lifecycle, process commands, queue, rename, and workflow modules. Web static coverage is grouped by shell, completed, queue, pending publish, settings, launch, rename, diagnostics/reports, and cross-page modules. The old Local API module contains no tests and points readers to the migration ledger.
manual_validation: adversarial split checks - passed (old broad test definitions absent, old Local API module has 0 tests, migration ledger has no unresolved rows)

rollback_plan: Revert the split test modules, restore the original application facade Local API/Web static test methods, and refresh generated summaries. No production code or media-processing behavior is changed by this packet.
